sourceOwner: Existing native PALM reader and Mass source-integrity programme (issue #894)
goal: Support complete source-owned schola chant sequence inside current Palm stages, without parallel processional app or new events.

primaryCrossReferences.note: Clearly differentiates Roman OHS and monastic OHM chant witnesses.

primaryCrossReferences.edition: Pueri Hebraeorum psalm tones and texts
primaryCrossReferences.note: Psalms printed in Vulgate verses, with instructions for alternating antiphons; not authoritative for making rite timing decisions.

findings.evidence: 1962 Roman chant witness: two Pueri Hebraeorum antiphons are sung with Psalms 23 and 46; present native payload has only antiphons.
missing: Antiphon repeat after every two verses
End-early handling: finish with Gloria Patri then antiphon
Repeat as needed while palms are distributed
findings.sequencePolicy: Chant progression may repeat with indefinite distribution duration; do not create misleading fixed timer or automated movement.

findings.evidence: 1961 LU 584-590 and Psallite Sapienter §§106-107 list a wider repertoire; optional antiphons depend on actual procession length.
missing: Optional antiphons, e.g. Occurrunt turbae, Cum angelis et pueris, Turba multa, Coeperunt, Omnes collaudant, Fulgentibus palmis, Ave
Associated Psalm 147 for Omnes collaudant when selected
Gloria laus verse lines and refrain alternation
findings.sequencePolicy: Do not force every optional chant, invent timings, or flatten chant alternatives into a fixed Mass script. Keep Gloria laus as a distinct required hymn event.

findings.evidence: Psallite Sapienter §108 and Liber Usualis p.590 identify Ingrediente response, verse Cumque audisset and repeated Cum ramis response.
missing: Return of final Cum ramis response

findings.evidence: Gospel follows palm distribution and precedes Procession in revised Roman Holy Week.
After blessing and procession Mass begins at Introit, prayers at foot omitted, Last Gospel suppressed as owned by current plan.

Represent Palm-R04 optional chants as conditional Schola interludes under existing event authority
Finish Gloria laus refrain/verse presentation only if locally sung; do not invent chant progression
Add Cumque audisset response pair for PALM-R05 without changing existing return boundary
Browser test a short distribution, long repeated distribution, abbreviated procession, long procession, and no-procession branch
